sentences.s: I shall define him as an individual who has elected as his primary duty and pleasure in life the activity of thinking in a Socratic (苏格拉底) way about moral problems.

components.原文: who has elected as his primary duty and pleasure in life the activity of thinking in a Socratic (苏格拉底) way about moral problems
components.中文翻译: 他把对道德问题进行苏格拉底式思考这一活动选作自己人生的首要责任和快乐
components.说明: who 引导定语从句修饰 an individual；从句内为 elect...as...固定搭配，宾语 the activity 因过长被移到宾补 as his primary duty... 之后，造成动宾分隔。

components.原文: of thinking in a Socratic (苏格拉底) way about moral problems
components.中文翻译: 对道德问题进行苏格拉底式思考的
components.说明: 介词短语作后置定语修饰 the activity，thinking 为动名词含动作义。

components.原文: in a Socratic (苏格拉底) way
components.说明: 介词短语作方式状语，修饰 thinking。

sentences.zh: 我将他定义为一个对道德问题进行苏格拉底式思考并将此作为自己人生首要责任和快乐的人。

sentences.s: His function is analogous to that of a judge, who must accept the obligation of revealing in as obvious a manner as possible the course of reasoning which led him to his decision.

trunk.宾语或表语: analogous to that of a judge
trunk.主干翻译: 他的职责与法官的职责相似。

components.原文: who must accept the obligation of revealing in as obvious a manner as possible the course of reasoning which led him to his decision
components.中文翻译: 法官必须承担这样的责任：用尽可能明了的方式来展示自己做出决定的推理过程
components.说明: who 引导非限制性定语从句补充说明 a judge 的职责，翻译时可与主句拆为两句。

components.原文: of revealing in as obvious a manner as possible the course of reasoning
components.说明: 介词短语作后置定语修饰 the obligation；revealing 的宾语 the course of reasoning 被移至方式状语之后，形成动宾分隔。

components.原文: in as obvious a manner as possible
components.说明: 套用 as+形容词+a+名词+as possible 结构作方式状语，修饰 revealing。

components.原文: which led him to his decision
components.说明: which 引导定语从句修饰 the course of reasoning。

sentences.zh: 他的职责与法官相似，必须承担这样的责任：用尽可能明了的方式来展示自己做出决定的推理过程。

sentences.s: I have excluded him because, while his accomplish\-ments may contribute to the solution of moral problems, he has not been charged with the task of approaching any but the factual aspects of those problems.

components.原文: because, while his accomplish\-ments may contribute to the solution of moral problems, he has not been charged with the task of approaching any but the factual aspects of those problems
components.中文翻译: 因为尽管他的成果可能会有助于解决道德问题，但他承担的任务只不过是研究这些问题的事实方面
components.说明: because 引导原因状语从句，说明将他排除的原因，内部又嵌套 while 让步从句。

components.原文: while his accomplish\-ments may contribute to the solution of moral problems
components.修饰对象: he has not been charged with the task
components.中文翻译: 尽管他的成果可能会有助于解决道德问题
components.说明: while 在此表让步（相当于 although），嵌套于 because 从句内，与主句 not...any but 的转折语义相呼应。

components.原文: of approaching any but the factual aspects of those problems
components.中文翻译: 研究这些问题事实方面的（任务）
components.说明: 介词短语作后置定语修饰 the task；not...any but 意为“仅仅”，approach 取“探讨/研究”义。

sentences.zh: 我之所以将他（普通科学家）排除在外，是因为尽管他的成果可能会有助于解决道德问题，但他承担的任务只不过是研究这些问题的事实方面。

sentences.s: But his primary task is not to think about the moral code which governs his activity, any more than a businessman is expected to dedicate his energies to an exploration of rules of conduct in business.

trunk.宾语或表语: not to think about the moral code
trunk.主干翻译: 但他的首要任务并不是考虑道德规范。

components.说明: which 引导定语从句修饰 the moral code，从句较短可前置译。

components.原文: any more than a businessman is expected to dedicate his energies to an exploration of rules of conduct in business
components.修饰对象: is not to think about the moral code
components.中文翻译: 就如同不能指望商人专注于探索行业规范一样
components.说明: not...any more than 结构引导比较状语从句，表示否定前者如同否定后者，从句 is expected 宜译为主动并增补泛指主语。

components.原文: to an exploration of rules of conduct in business
components.说明: 介词短语作 dedicate his energies to 的宾语部分，rules of conduct 与 moral code 呼应，均指“道德规范”。

sentences.zh: 但是，他的首要任务并不是考虑支配自己行动的道德规范，就如同不能指望商人专注于探索行业规范一样。

sentences.s: They may teach very well, and more than earn their salaries, but most of them make little or no independent reflections on human problems which involve moral judgment.

trunk.主干翻译: 他们大多数人却很少或没有进行独立思考。

components.原文: They may teach very well, and more than earn their salaries
components.中文翻译: 他们可以教得很好，而且不仅仅是为了挣薪水
components.说明: but 之前的并列分句，与后一分句形成转折；more than earn 意为“不仅仅是挣得”。

components.原文: on human problems which involve moral judgment
components.中文翻译: 对需要进行道德判断的、人的问题
components.说明: 介词短语作 reflections 的定语，指出独立思考所针对的对象。
which 引导定语从句修饰 human problems。

sentences.zh: 他们可以教得很好，而且不仅仅是为了挣薪水，但他们大多数人却很少或没有对需要进行道德判断的、人的问题进行独立思考。
